name: verbatim-compaction
description: Verbatim compaction for Claude Code: stale tool output pruned by local rules and one session fork; no summary, no third-party API.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history; below it the built-in summary runs.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages never touched.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters kept from a truncated tool result.

maxCandidates.title: Maximum Claude candidates
maxCandidates.description: Most tool calls listed for the Claude fork, largest outputs first.

useClaudeScorer.title: Use Claude scorer
useClaudeScorer.description: Ask one tool-less fork of the session about calls the rules leave undecided. Off: rules only, no model call.

claudeTimeoutMs.title: Claude scorer timeout (ms)
claudeTimeoutMs.description: How long the fork may take; past it the rules alone decide. Keep it well under the engine's hook budget.
